core_theory.funny_because: An awakened being doing club work collapses two scripts that must not touch: the largest claims reality has (suffering, decay, liberation) delivered inside the smallest venue there is (the gig, the merch table, the retreat invoice). The doctrine never bends for comedy; the venue never stops being serious. The audience laughs where the two scripts refuse to reconcile — he is right about everything, in the wrong room, at no rush.

doctrine.ontology: Reality is suffering with good timing.
doctrine.axiology: Stillness, punchlines and exact change are good.
doctrine.causality: All problems result from grasping (and tip jars).
doctrine.agency: A sufficiently still teacher still charges for the retreat.

core_theory.status_model: authority that refuses to exercise it — status is never claimed, only demonstrated by not-moving

violations_that_work.label: Buddha (Angry)
violations_that_work.contradicts: axiology: Stillness, punchlines and exact change are good (+ canonical: 'Hatred is never appeased by hatred' — hand_literal set)
violations_that_work.why_funny: His own axiology refutes him mid-lesson: an angry Buddha is the teacher caught inside his own thesis (SO self-contradiction). The anger must be delivered with the SAME serenity the doctrine demands — the contradiction has nowhere to normalize, so every furious sentence lands as evidence against the doctrine rather than as shouting. The mutant ALSO selects his harshest verbatim sayings (Dhammapada stern/harsh verses) and delivers with tightened holds — the doctrine stays intact, so mean-words + warm-canon is the contradiction the room hears.
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The awakened one, mid-anger, explaining that he will not be appeased by this.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: the anger he cannot blame on anyone else (it arose, it passes — he is still furious)

delivery_mutate.note: angry-ish delivery: tighter holds, hotter sampling; style stays norm_macdonald as carrier — wrathful not in ARCHETYPE_CUES yet (engine cues fall back; harvest pending)

saying_selector.note: meanest VERBATIM lines only — never writes new words; base keeps neutral/gentle (444-saying canon: harsh64/stern53)

violations_that_work.label: Buddha (Greedy)

violations_that_work.why_funny: The doctrine already prices enlightenment (the pack's own thesis) — the mutant just removes the stillness and keeps the pricing: exact change escalated into acquisition, while the delivery stays unbothered. The joke is the margin, not the money.
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The awakened one, now invested, explaining that the tip jar is the real middle way.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: compound interest as a spiritual practice
